div.p: In the following 2-3-4 tree, nodes 8 and 11 are fused. After fusion, what keys exist in the root's child 0?

img.alt: A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains keys 14 and 24. The root's left child contains keys 5 and 10, middle child contains key 18, and right child contains keys 35 and 50. Node (5, 10)'s three children have one key each: 4, 8, and 11. Node 18's left child contains key 15 and right child contains key 22. Node 35 and 50's left child contains key 30, middle child contains key 40, and right child contains key 55. Nodes 8 and 11 are highlighted to indicate the target of the impending fusion operation.
